headline: Vilnius Nights: four clubs, one €10 ticket
standfirst: In 2026, Vilnius Days, the Lithuanian capital's 33-year-old street festival, extended into Vilnius Nights for the first time. Four nightclubs stayed open until 6AM, and one €10 ticket got you into all of them.
body: In 2026, Vilnius Days, the Lithuanian capital's 33-year-old street festival, extended into Vilnius Nights for the first time. Four nightclubs stayed open until 6AM, and one €10 ticket got you into all of them.

The Vilnius Night Office ran the initiative. The city municipality set up this public institution in 2023. It gives venues financial aid, offers staff training and mental health support, and runs harm reduction campaigns.
The event came months after Opium Club, open since 2009, closed in February. Mixmag also visited Draugų Vardai, an art and music space with a custom-built soundsystem.

headline: Tourism boom squeezes Reykjavík's music venues
standfirst: Tourism-driven gentrification is pushing Reykjavík's music venues out to make way for hotels and restaurants, artists and industry figures told Mixmag during Iceland Airwaves.
body: Tourism-driven gentrification is pushing Reykjavík's music venues out to make way for hotels and restaurants, artists and industry figures told Mixmag during Iceland Airwaves.

The festival's 27th edition ran across just seven spaces, including punk bar Lemmy, the Kolaport market hall, an independent church and City Hall. Producer Ida Juhl, aka knackered, says DIY crews host parties in bars they don't own: "pull up, build the stage and build the sound."
A newly formed Reykjavík Nighttime Industries Advocacy Group is now working to support and protect the city's venues.

headline: Mamdani names Eric Thor NYC nightlife director
standfirst: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has named Eric Thor Executive Director of the city's Office of Nightlife. Mamdani announced the appointment on Friday, November 13.
body: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has named Eric Thor Executive Director of the city's Office of Nightlife. Mamdani announced the appointment on Friday, November 13.

Thor was born in Queens and was previously lead developer at LaborLab, an organisation that supports unionisation. He will meet workers, business owners and community members across all five boroughs to shape the office's priorities, with a focus on working conditions and licensing.
“Nightlife is for everyone, from clubs to queer spaces to immigrant-run venues,” Thor said.

headline: Detroit to celebrate the life of Juan Atkins
standfirst: The family of Juan Atkins will host a public celebration of the electronic music pioneer's life and legacy on Sunday, November 22nd, at The Lincoln Factory in Detroit.
body: The family of Juan Atkins will host a public celebration of the electronic music pioneer's life and legacy on Sunday, November 22nd, at The Lincoln Factory in Detroit.
The 12-hour gathering is open to family, friends, fans and fellow artists. In its Instagram announcement, the family wrote: "All are welcome. Please celebrate his life and work with us."
Atkins died on November 1st in Mexico City, aged 64. His foundational role in Detroit techno helped establish a musical language that has shaped generations of producers and DJs worldwide.
